verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official MCP server, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. It also documents a separate hosted MCP server option with its own setup guide, so agents can connect through either a local or a hosted endpoint. The evidence consists mostly of page titles and a probe, so it shows the server exists but not how deep it goes. Missing for 10: detail on the exposed tools and capabilities, auth/setup specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
